avoid.name: Raw or undercooked eggs
avoid.why: Risk of salmonella; choose fully cooked eggs or pasteurized products like most store-bought mayo.

avoid.name: Unpasteurized (raw) milk and juices
avoid.why: Can carry listeria and other bacteria that pregnancy makes you more vulnerable to.

avoid.name: Soft cheeses from unpasteurized milk
avoid.why: Brie, Camembert, queso fresco and similar can harbor listeria unless labeled pasteurized.

avoid.name: High-mercury fish (shark, swordfish, king mackerel, tilefish, bigeye tuna)
avoid.why: Mercury can affect your baby's developing nervous system; low-mercury fish are still encouraged.

avoid.name: Raw or undercooked fish and shellfish
avoid.why: Sushi-grade raw fish, raw oysters and ceviche carry bacteria and parasites best avoided now.

avoid.name: Deli meats and hot dogs (unless steaming hot)
avoid.why: Can carry listeria; heating until steaming makes them safe to enjoy.

avoid.name: Refrigerated pâtés and meat spreads
avoid.why: Listeria risk; canned or shelf-stable versions are a safe alternative.

avoid.name: Refrigerated smoked seafood
avoid.why: Listeria risk unless it's cooked into a dish; canned smoked fish is fine.

avoid.name: Alcohol
avoid.why: No amount is known to be safe during pregnancy — this is the one firm rule.

avoid.name: Unwashed produce
avoid.why: Soil residue can carry toxoplasma; a good rinse under running water solves it.

avoid.name: Raw sprouts (alfalfa, clover, mung bean)
avoid.why: Bacteria can hide inside the seed where washing can't reach; cooked sprouts are fine.

avoid.name: Excess caffeine (over ~200 mg/day)
avoid.why: High intake is linked to lower birth weight; one small coffee a day is generally considered fine.

avoid.name: Energy drinks
avoid.why: High caffeine plus unstudied stimulant blends — skip them for now.

avoid.name: Liver and liver products
avoid.why: Very high in preformed vitamin A, which can be harmful in large amounts.

avoid.name: Cod liver oil supplements
avoid.why: Same vitamin A concern as liver; choose a prenatal-safe omega-3 instead.

avoid.name: Raw cookie dough or cake batter
avoid.why: Raw egg and raw flour both carry bacteria; bake first, then lick the spoon.

avoid.name: Homemade or deli-counter salads
avoid.why: Chicken, tuna, and egg salads sitting at temperature are a classic listeria risk.

avoid.name: Unpasteurized honey (raw honey in large amounts)
avoid.why: Fine for adults, but pasteurized honey is the cautious choice during pregnancy.

avoid.name: Herbal teas without a safety check
avoid.why: Some herbs (like licorice root, chamomile in quantity, raspberry leaf early on) aren't well studied in pregnancy.

avoid.name: Licorice root (candy and tea)
avoid.why: Regular consumption has been linked to effects on the baby's development.

avoid.name: Undercooked meat and poultry
avoid.why: Toxoplasma and bacteria risk; use a thermometer and cook through.

avoid.name: Buffet or picnic food left out over 2 hours
avoid.why: Bacteria multiply quickly at room temperature — when in doubt, skip it.

avoid.name: Excess vitamin A supplements
avoid.why: Stick to your prenatal's formulation; more is not better for fat-soluble vitamins.

avoid.name: Sushi with raw fish
avoid.why: Same raw-seafood risk; cooked rolls (tempura, eel, California) are a lovely workaround.

avoid.name: Saccharine and unstudied sweeteners in quantity
avoid.why: Most common sweeteners are considered fine in moderation, but saccharine crosses the placenta and data is thin.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Greek yogurt with honey and frozen berries
cravingSwaps.why: Same cold, creamy satisfaction with protein and calcium your baby's bones will use tonight.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Salted popcorn or roasted chickpeas
cravingSwaps.why: Crunch and salt, with fiber that keeps energy steadier than a chip bag can.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Dark chocolate squares with almonds
cravingSwaps.why: A little dark chocolate satisfies deeply; the almonds add magnesium and staying power.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Sparkling water with a splash of real juice
cravingSwaps.why: Bubbles and sweetness without the sugar spike — and it hydrates you both.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Oven-baked sweet potato wedges
cravingSwaps.why: Crispy edges, plus beta-carotene that supports your baby's cell growth.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Pickles, just mind the sodium elsewhere that day
cravingSwaps.why: This one's actually fine — vinegar cravings are classic; balance salt across your meals.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Whole-grain toast with avocado
cravingSwaps.why: Keeps the comfort, adds folate and healthy fats for the brain.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Banana smoothie with milk and peanut butter
cravingSwaps.why: Thick and sweet with protein, calcium, and potassium instead of a sugar crash.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Soba or whole-grain noodles with soft-boiled egg and greens
cravingSwaps.why: Ten more minutes, infinitely more iron, choline, and folate.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Whole-grain toast with ricotta, honey, and cinnamon
cravingSwaps.why: Warm, sweet, and creamy — with protein that carries you past mid-morning.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Cheese, paired with apple slices or whole-grain crackers
cravingSwaps.why: Keep the cheese (pasteurized) — just add fiber so it's a snack, not a vanishing act.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Baked oatmeal with berries and a drizzle of maple
cravingSwaps.why: Feels like dessert for breakfast and quietly delivers iron and fiber.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Frozen grapes or tart dried mango
cravingSwaps.why: Sharp, sweet, and fun to eat — with actual vitamin C along for the ride.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Homemade lean beef or bean burger with all the toppings
cravingSwaps.why: You control the cook temperature and get clean iron and protein, not just salt.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Coconut yogurt or lightly whipped ricotta with vanilla
cravingSwaps.why: Still clouds-on-a-spoon, with a little protein underneath.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: One morning coffee, then iced rooibos or decaf with milk
cravingSwaps.why: Keeps the ritual while staying comfortably under the caffeine line.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Fortified whole-grain cereal with milk — genuinely a good call
cravingSwaps.why: This craving is your body asking for folate and iron; say yes.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Greek yogurt with lemon zest and a little honey
cravingSwaps.why: Sour cravings are common in pregnancy; this one adds calcium to the fix.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Whole-wheat pita pizzas loaded with vegetables
cravingSwaps.why: Same melty comfort, faster than delivery, and you sneak in folate-rich greens.

cravingSwaps.healthierSwap: Crispy mushrooms or a little well-cooked turkey bacon
cravingSwaps.why: Smoky and savory with less saturated fat and sodium on repeat days.
